label: SHUGYO
head: One thing, 100 days straight
sub: Miss a single day and the count goes back to zero.

label: GANBARU
head: Finish it after the interest dies
sub: No audience, no reward. You said you would.

label: SEIZA
head: Sit still 5 minutes, no phone
sub: Spine straight. Most men reach for the phone inside a minute.

label: HARA HACHI BU
head: Stop eating at 80% full
sub: Do it for 30 days. Okinawans have for centuries.

label: SHOKUNIN
head: Do one boring task perfectly
sub: Fold the shirt, make the bed, tie your shoes like someone's grading it.

label: GAMAN
head: Carry it without complaining
sub: Not hiding it. Just not making it everyone's problem.
